attributes.description: Inventory Shadow AI tools on Windows endpoints — local LLMs, AI coding agents, AI desktop applications, MCP servers (MCP config file presence, metadata only), AI model files, Python/npm AI packages, browser extensions, Docker containers, Windows services, scheduled tasks, GPU-equipped systems, AI API key exposure, and AI tool configuration directories, vector databases, and model cache sizes.
attributes.name: ai-asset-discovery-windows

queries.query:
SELECT

    p.path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid,
    u.username,
    p.resident_size,
    datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time,
    p.parent AS ppid
FROM processes p
LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
WHERE p.name IN ('ollama', 'ollama.exe', 'lms', 'lms.exe', 'gpt4all', 'gpt4all.exe', 'jan', 'jan.exe', 'msty', 'msty.exe', 'local-ai', 'local-ai.exe', 'koboldcpp', 'koboldcpp.exe', 'llama-server', 'llama-server.exe', 'llama-cli', 'llama-cli.exe', 'vllm', 'vllm.exe', 'mlc_llm', 'mlc_llm.exe', 'mlc_chat', 'mlc_chat.exe', 'anythingllm', 'anythingllm.exe', 'anything-llm', 'anything-llm.exe', 'litellm', 'litellm.exe', 'open-webui', 'open-webui.exe', 'llamafile', 'llamafile.exe', 'text-generation-launcher', 'text-generation-launcher.exe', 'text-generation-router', 'text-generation-router.exe', 'comfyui', 'comfyui.exe', 'invokeai', 'invokeai.exe', 'Msty.exe', 'exo', 'exo.exe', 'tabby', 'tabby.exe', 'qwen', 'qwen.exe', 'grok', 'grok.exe')

    OR p.path LIKE '%\\LM Studio\\%'
    OR p.path LIKE '%\\GPT4All\\%'

    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mlc_llm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%localai%'
    OR p.cmdline LIKE '%text-generation-webui%'

;

SELECT
    l.port,
    l.address,
    l.protocol,
    p.name,
    p.path,
    p.cmdline,
    p.pid
FROM listening_ports l
JOIN processes p ON l.pid = p.pid
WHERE (
    l.port IN (11434, 1234, 7860, 6333, 6334, 19530)
    OR (
        l.port IN (43411, 4891, 1337, 5001, 8080, 8000, 4000, 3000, 3001, 8188, 9090, 1000, 8501, 8265, 9099, 5678, 8888)
        AND (
            p.name IN (
                'ollama.exe', 'lms.exe', 'gpt4all.exe', 'jan.exe', 'vllm.exe',
                'litellm.exe', 'koboldcpp.exe', 'llama-server.exe', 'llamafile.exe',
                'open-webui.exe', 'anythingllm.exe', 'comfyui.exe', 'invokeai.exe',
                'qdrant.exe', 'milvus.exe', 'weaviate.exe', 'chroma.exe',
                'claude.exe', 'Cursor.exe', 'windsurf.exe', 'copilot-agent.exe',
                'aider.exe', 'codex.exe', 'tabby.exe', 'exo.exe'
            )
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%litellm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama.cpp%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%open-webui%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%anythingllm%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%chromadb%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%qdrant%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%weaviate%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%milvus%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol%'
        )
    )
    OR (
        l.port = 18789
        AND (
            p.cmdline LIKE '%openclaw%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%moltbot%'
            OR p.cmdline LIKE '%clawdbot%'
            OR p.name LIKE '%openclaw%'
        )
    )
)
    AND l.address != '127.0.0.1'
    AND l.address != '::1';

SELECT
    name,
    version,
    install_location,
    publisher,
    install_date,
    CASE
        WHEN name LIKE '%GitHub Copilot%' OR name LIKE '%Copilot CLI%' THEN 'developer'
        WHEN name LIKE '%Microsoft 365 Copilot%' OR name LIKE '%Copilot for Microsoft%' OR name LIKE '%Microsoft Copilot%' THEN 'productivity'
        WHEN name LIKE '%Copilot%' THEN 'unknown'
        ELSE NULL

FROM programs
WHERE name LIKE '%Ollama%' OR name LIKE '%LM Studio%' OR name LIKE '%ChatGPT%'

SELECT

    filename,
    size,
    datetime(mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time,
    datetime(atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time
FROM file

    path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ollama\models\blobs\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.lmstudio\models\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\huggingface\hub\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.cache\llama.cpp\%'
    OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\nomic.ai\GPT4All\%'

AND size > 104857600;

SELECT
    np.name AS package_name,
    np.version,
    np.description,
    np.path,
    np.directory
FROM npm_packages np
WHERE np.directory IN ('C:\Program Files\nodejs\node_modules')
AND (
    np.name LIKE '@modelcontextprotocol/%'
    OR np.name LIKE 'mcp-server-%'
    OR np.name LIKE '@anthropic-ai/%'
    OR np.name LIKE '@elastic/mcp%'
    OR np.name LIKE '@github/mcp-server%'
    OR np.name LIKE 'mcp-remote%'
)
UNION
SELECT
    regex_match(f.path, '.*[\\/]node_modules[\\/](@[^\\/]+[\\/][^\\/]+|[^\\/]+)[\\/]package.json', 1) AS package_name,
    '' AS version,
    '' AS description,
    f.path,
    f.directory
FROM file f
WHERE (

SELECT
    p.name AS process_name,
    p.path AS process_path,
    p.pid,
    u.username,
    sens.path AS sensitive_file_path,
    sens.size AS sensitive_file_size,
    datetime(sens.atime, 'unixepoch') AS accessed_time,
    datetime(sens.mtime, 'unixepoch') AS modified_time
FROM processes p
JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid
JOIN (
    SELECT path, size, atime, mtime, uid
    FROM file
    WHERE path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.aws\credentials'
        OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.aws\config'
        OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ssh\id_rsa'
        OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ssh\id_ed25519'
        OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\.ssh\id_ecdsa'
        OR path LIKE 'C:\Users\%\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Login Data'

SELECT p.name AS process_name, p.path AS process_path, p.cmdline, p.pid, u.username, pos.remote_address, pos.remote_port, pos.local_port, pos.local_address, pos.state, CASE pos.family WHEN 2 THEN 'IPv4' WHEN 10 THEN 'IPv6' ELSE 'unknown' END AS address_family, CASE pos.protocol WHEN 6 THEN 'tcp' WHEN 17 THEN 'udp' ELSE CAST(pos.protocol AS TEXT) END AS transport_protocol, CASE WHEN pos.remote_address LIKE '10.%' OR pos.remote_address LIKE '192.168.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_rfc1918_destination, datetime(p.start_time, 'unixepoch') AS start_time FROM process_open_sockets pos JOIN processes p ON pos.pid = p.pid LEFT JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid WHERE pos.remote_address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1', '::1', '0.0.0.0', '::') AND pos.remote_address != '' AND (pos.state IN ('ESTABLISHED', 'CLOSE_WAIT', 'SYN_SENT') OR pos.state IS NULL) AND ( p.name IN ('ollama.exe', 'claude.exe', 'Cursor.exe', 'windsurf.exe', 'ChatGPT.exe', 'copilot-agent.exe', 'aider.exe', 'codex.exe', 'lms.exe', 'gpt4all.exe', 'jan.exe', 'llama-server.exe', 'open-webui.exe', 'litellm.exe', 'koboldcpp.exe', 'vllm.exe', 'llamafile.exe', 'tabby.exe', 'exo.exe', 'qwen.exe', 'grok.exe', 'gemini-cli.exe', 'genaiscript.exe', 'openai.exe', 'llm.exe', 'bolt.exe', 'replit.exe', 'ghostwriter.exe', 'bito.exe', 'devin', 'devin.exe', 'goose', 'goose.exe', 'warp', 'warp.exe', 'zed', 'zed.exe', 'augment', 'augment.exe', 'supermaven', 'supermaven.exe') OR p.cmdline LIKE '%ollama serve%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%claude-code%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%cursor-retrieval%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%codeium%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%github.copilot%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%llama-server%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%vllm.entrypoints%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%mcp-server%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%@modelcontextprotocol%'
